Our Editor's Take

The Banter is a comedic podcast that focuses on sports, pop culture, and the zany antics of its three hosts. Hunter, Konner, and Trevor have been friends for several years and share a passion for disc golf. They also share a similar, off-kilter sense of humor. That is the primary engine that makes the podcast a compelling listen.
The Banter , as its name implies, is very much conversation-oriented. It's not only a disc golf podcast. The three hosts have a wide variety of opinions on any given topic and are not shy about sharing them when asked to do so. With that in mind, the humor here is more silly and broad than acidic, but often with adult language.
